question: Rukmini Devi Arundale was awarded with 'Padma Bhushan' in the year ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1956**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rukmini Devi Arundale:-**

 
 
• She was awarded with 'Padma Bhushan' in the year 1956.
 
• She was an Indian classical dancer, choreographer, and founder of Kalakshetra Foundation in Chennai.
 
• Rukmini Devi Arundale was a pioneer in reviving and promoting Bharatanatyam, a classical dance form of South India.
 
• She was also a member of the Rajya Sabha, the upper house of the Indian Parliament.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **She was awarded with Padma Bhushan in 1956.**
 
• **She was awarded with Padma Shri in 1963.**
